Jordan Spence buries a rush shot from between the circles. 4-2 game with 13:36 left to play.
Terrible last few minutes here for the Senators. Feels like an early season game from last season. Blown scoring opps in the o-zone, glaring defensive miscues winding up in the back of their net.
Yakemchuk with a seeing eye shot off the post through traffic. 2-0 Sens
Tim Stutzle buries one on the delayed penalty. 1-0 Sens

The Senators have played horrendously in front of Samuel Ersson in the second half of their back-to-back starts this season. Looking forward to seeing tonight's effort after last night's emotional win.
Lost in a lot of the post-Tkachuk revenge commotion, Linus Ullmark is on injured reserve. #Sens.
Sens are blasting Mr Brightside in their dressing room right now.
Stephen Halliday snipes off a Timmy pass and what a celly. 5-1 Sens.
Cozens with an unbelievable move and drop pass to Foegele, who buries it. 4-1 Sens.
Sens score, Pinto on a partial breakaway. 3-1 Sens
Claude Giroux fires one through traffic. 2-1 Sens
Artem Zub throwing f-bombs at Gudas. What a night.
Timmy Stutzle buries a Sandy feed on the PP. 1-1 game
Hodgson yells at the Panthers' bench after the tilt and gives the Chris Neil 'raise the roof' post-fight gesture to get the fans going.
Weird. The first five Senators on the ice this morning are Andre Roy, Brian McGrattan, Denny Lambert, Matt Carkner and Dennis Vial.
